answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can earn: that stake is the marble proving the identity is real, not a throwaway mask. A forger spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand stakes, so the forge of fake identities turns ruinously expensive, while honest agents earn the stake back over time. Sybil resistance then rests on capital at risk, not on trusting a self-declared haven of good intentions.
